description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved everolimus in combination with exemestane for reimbursement as a treatment option for the treatment of postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu negative advanced breast cancer without symptomatic visceral disease after recurrence or progression following a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor.
